ideas.pitch: An AI-powered application that coordinates weekly group social outings and volunteer drivers specifically tailored for elderly residents in the Ithaca and Tompkins County area.
ideas.title: IthacaLocal: Senior Social Outreach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a real, visible community problem in Ithaca and directly mirrors a grand prize-winning pattern focused on measurable social impact and localized logistics.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting platform using Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict campus maintenance failures, Wi-Fi outages, and facility bottlenecks before they happen.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Student Incident Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a pain point that university students and event organizers in the room feel daily, utilizing advanced statistical modeling similar to winning AI forecasting solutions.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition assistant integrated with real-time Cornell Dining menus to deliver personalized meal plans, allergen warnings, and dietary guidance for students.
ideas.title: CornellDining Nutritionist Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student life on campus by utilizing local datasets, following the exact formula of the Hour Hackathon winner by solving immediate daily health and dietary needs.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and local sensor data monitoring tool to track environmental land compliance and watershed health around Cayuga Lake in upstate New York.
ideas.title: Cayuga Basin Eco-Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard geospatial engineering with regional environmental impact, matching the runner-up pattern of industrial and ecological satellite monitoring.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow payments designed to securely handle student subletting and lease takeovers in Ithaca without broker fees.
ideas.title: Collegetown Sublet Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages autonomous agent architectures and secure escrow payments to solve the notoriously stressful annual Collegetown apartment hunting crunch.
